premise: Inside a locked private study on the estate, two adults: a controlling mother and her adult child. She deploys surveillance-sourced material presented as evidence—photographs, dossier-style personal detail, and a concealed romantic or infatuation-based attachment to a third party—to exert proprietary authority and coercive emotional pressure and to tighten the same mother–adult child control and dependency-tinged dynamic; the surface conflict is study-bound, evidence-forward inquiry and cross-examination rather than care or comfort as the dominant register. All participants in this scene are adults.
